prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Atlanta after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I can name 4–6 Atlanta personal-injury firms to call and explain why each is a good fit. Before I pick the best matches, two quick questions so my list is useful for your situation:

1. What Atlanta ZIP code or neighborhood are you in (or which county did the crash happen)?  
2. How serious are your injuries (minor/no treatment, ongoing treatment, hospitalization, permanent injury, or fatality/wrongful death)?  
3. Do you know whether the at-fault driver has insurance, and are you dealing with an insurer already?

If you’d rather get a quick general list now, I can give a short set of widely‑used Atlanta firms to call immediately and what to ask them (contingency fee, who will handle the case, trial experience, past outcomes, expected timeline). Which do you prefer?
